user_query: I am a stock trader looking for potential investment opportunities. Could you suggest some stocks that have the Bullish Harami pattern and are RSI Overbought? It would be helpful to see the volume and closing prices of these stocks.

TaskList.description: Fetch the list of stocks with the Bullish Harami pattern.
Filter the fetched stocks to identify those that are RSI Overbought.
Retrieve the volume and closing prices for the stocks identified in the previous task.
